nvitk.io.conversors¶

CLI-style converters (DICOM→NIfTI, vendor-specific pipelines, STL, etc.).

Each submodule exposes a callable with its own parameters; see their docstrings.

Functions¶

dcm2nii(→ str | list[str])

Convert a DICOM series (or directory of series) to NIfTI; library entry point behind the dcm2nii CLI.

nikon2nifti(→ str)

Convert a Nikon ND2 file to NIfTI; library entry point behind the nikon2nifti CLI.

phase2volume(→ list[pathlib.Path])

Library entry point behind the phase2volume CLI: convert one patient, or every patient under input_path

stl2nifti(→ str | list[str])

Thin wrapper over run_stl2nifti() returning a single path instead of a list when there's exactly one output.
